title: That was the meaning of Tower of Ivory.
html_source:
From the Song of Solomon 7:4 KJV

“Thy neck is as a tower of ivory; thine eyes like the fishpools in Heshbon, by the gate of Bathrabbim: thy nose is as the tower of Lebanon which looketh toward Damascus.”

‘An ivory tower’ is a term used to describe intellectuals/thinkers who are in such a place of thought that they are disconnected from the practical ordinary world.

This is someone similar to how Stephen feels. He is very intellectual and perspective, especially for someone so young. Yet he still is detached from the world, like when he feels discontent at playing the football games and continuously ponders and analyzes everything.
